intro: McDonald's is the world's biggest fast-food chain, home of the Big Mac, Quarter Pounder, Chicken McNuggets and the world-famous fries. The McValue menu brings back cheap combos, breakfast runs until 10:30, and the McFlurry and shakes finish it off. Below is the full McDonald's menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A McDonald's Big Mac is about $5.99 ($10.19 as a meal), a Quarter Pounder with Cheese is $6.49, and a 10-piece McNuggets is $5.79. The budget picks are the McDouble ($3.59) and the McValue $5 and $6 Meal Deals. Medium world-famous fries are about $3.99.
hot_deal: McDonald's McValue: the $5 Meal Deal (McChicken or McDouble, 4-piece McNuggets, small fries and a drink) and the $6 Meal Deal are the headline deals, and the 'Under $3' menu mixes and matches cheap favorites. The best deals are app-only, so order through the McDonald's app. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a Big Mac?
faqs.a: A Big Mac is about $5.99 on its own, or around $10.19 as a meal with medium fries and a drink. It is roughly 563 calories. Prices are set by each franchise and vary by location.

faqs.q: What is the McValue menu at McDonald's?
faqs.a: McValue is McDonald's value lineup: the $5 Meal Deal (a main, 4-piece McNuggets, small fries and a drink), the $6 Meal Deal, and an 'Under $3' mix-and-match menu with items like the McDouble.

faqs.q: What time does McDonald's stop serving breakfast?
faqs.a: Most McDonald's serve breakfast until 10:30 AM on weekdays and 11:00 AM on weekends, after which the lunch menu starts. Breakfast is not available all day.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Big Mac?
faqs.a: A Big Mac is about 563 calories. A Quarter Pounder with Cheese is around 520, and a medium order of fries adds roughly 378, so a full Big Mac meal lands near 1,100 calories.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at McDonald's?
faqs.a: The best known are the Big Mac, the Quarter Pounder with Cheese, Chicken McNuggets, the World-Famous Fries, and the McFlurry.
